poseConvergence.scope: 8-car asymmetric mixed train, matched 3D station comparisons and stopped handover. Pairwise refinement is evidence, not a certified geometric error bound or real Godot rendering validation.

gapMeasurement.scope: Positive separating-axis gap is a lower bound on box distance at a sampled pose; not the exact Euclidean distance and not a continuous sweep bound. Adjacent bodies only, intentional coupler/contact interfaces excluded.
